title: agent-doctor checks file
description: Schema for checks.default.json and user checks.json (merged over built-ins by id).

id.description: Unique id (e.g. 'agent-cli:claude'). User checks override built-ins by id.

label.description: Human-readable name shown in the report.

tier.description: fast = no network (session-start hook); deep = network/spawns (on demand).

throttleHours.description: Cache the result for N hours (deep network probes).

expectOutput.description: exec: regex the output must match to PASS (judged by output, not exit code).

missing.description: exec/fileJson: behavior when the target is absent (default skip).

optional.description: exec: a present-but-unverified tool SKIPs instead of FAILs.

url.description: http/ollamaTags: URL. http URLs support ${ENV:VAR} interpolation.

headers.description: http: headers; values support ${ENV:VAR} (skips if unset).

skipIfDown.description: http/port: SKIP instead of FAIL when unreachable (optional services).

requireKeys.description: fileJson: keys that must be present + non-empty.

writesQuery.description: memwrite: SQL returning the count of stored memories.

inputsQuery.description: memwrite: SQL returning the count of inputs/prompts.

minInputs.description: memwrite: minimum inputs before flagging a silent failure (default 5).

config.description: mcp: path to the MCP config file (default ~/.claude.json). Probed servers run the real JSON-RPC handshake (initialize -> notifications/initialized -> tools/list); 0 tools advertised is WARN.
